mentions.name: Bloks
mentions.description: A local, offline-first training plan builder for planning workouts, offering more intuitive controls than existing services like TrainingPeaks and aiming to be 10-20% better than using a spreadsheet like Excel. It currently works for the builder's own training needs.
mentions.problem: Existing training plan services like TrainingPeaks have controls that are not intuitive unless you are a coach in their system.
mentions.audience: A personal, local tool the author uses for their own training needs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Started working on a training plan builder after getting frustrated with trying to use an existing service (trainingpeaks) and not finding the controls intuitive enough without being a coach in their system.

https://bloks.run/

I wanted something local and offline first + 10-20% better than excel
